rows.description: I see a police officer and wonder if they are kind or scary. I feel curious. A wise parent teaches "police are helpers, go to them if you are lost". Using police as a threat to a child makes them fear help.

rows.description: A visiting uncle says "give me a kiss" and my parent says I must. I feel uncomfortable. A wise parent respects a child's "no" to hugs and offers a wave or high five. My body belongs to me.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: fear, manipulation, trust
this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3
related mind states: affection, admiration

rows.description: I know I can tell Mummy anything, even a secret someone asked me to keep. I feel safe. A wise parent says "no adult should ask you to keep a secret from us". Trust to tell is my best protection.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: coercion, curiosity, respect
related mind states: trust

rows.description: An adult touches me in a way that feels wrong and says "don't tell". I feel frightened and confused. It is never my fault. Wise action: tell a trusted grown-up right away, and keep telling until someone helps.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: curiosity, respect, trust
related mind states: fear, confusion, trust

rows.description: I hold my parent's hand crossing the road and stop at the red light. I feel proud when I follow the rule. Wise adults explain why in simple words and model the rule themselves.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: coercion, curiosity, trust
related mind states: admiration, pride

rows.description: I want to climb the wall, touch the hot pot or run ahead. My curiosity is strong and I do not judge danger well. Wise adults set clear firm safety limits and give safe ways to explore and be brave.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: coercion, respect, trust
related mind states: anger, curiosity, trust

rows.description: I know my name, my parents' phone number and which adults I can ask if lost. I feel prepared. Practicing simple safety plans as play makes a child confident instead of scared.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: coercion, curiosity, respect
related mind states: fear, detachment, trust

rows.description: At the shop I beg for a toy and my parent says no. I do not understand price yet. A wise parent explains "we have money for the fruit today" simply. Buying to stop a tantrum teaches me that crying pays.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: curiosity, envy, fairness, pride
related mind states: sadness

rows.description: I hand over the coin and get change and feel very grown up. Money is a magic exchange to me. A wise parent lets me try, teaching that things cost and coins are worth different amounts.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: argument, envy, fairness, pride

rows.description: I put coins in my piggy bank and count them. I feel proud and patient waiting to buy something I want. Saving a little teaches that waiting can bring more, an early lesson in delayed reward.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: argument, curiosity, envy, fairness
related mind states: pride
